scope: Native v6 private page lifecycle only; synthetic accepted Source4 fixtures and actual BusinessSession/widget implementations.
finding: Before the shared-editor fix, an actual listener registered in _BusinessEditorState.initState remained attached to the old BusinessSession after widget/session replacement. The independent instrumented assertion failed. After the root-owned business_widgets.dart fix, the same assertion and all other five cases pass. No reappearing visible private content was observed in the original failure.

fix.reviewed_change: Rebind session listener in didUpdateWidget; invalidate and clear old-context draft; capture submitting context for pending state and reject late completion/error updates in a changed context.

cases: Session replacement closes the private editor and detaches every tracked old-session listener.
Employee replacement discards a delayed successful correction preview.
Approve permission withdrawal while read remains allowed closes the editor and discards delayed preview.
Session replacement suppresses a delayed private preview ApiException.
Backgrounding during held original-source authorization prevents the original callback, including after resume.
Employee context replacement suppresses a delayed private history ApiException.

limitations: Widget checks use fake transport with synthetic accepted Source4 fixtures; this report does not assert backend or production payroll release completion.
The original-document case checks authorization before the callback; it does not assert cancellation of an external viewer callback that already started.
Shared-editor direct regression and the owner v6 suite are verified separately by their respective owners.
Captured hashes identify files after this run, in a shared working tree; no immutable repository snapshot is claimed.
